notes.title: Datascape is now Free to Play and Update v1.1.0!!!
notes.notes:
With the anniversary of Datascape the game is now free to play coming alongside an update!

Thank you to everyone who purchased the game and flew around the GRID!

If you enjoy your time, please consider purchasing our DLC (coming soon). To help us pay rent and buy cat food! It is much appreciated!

[i]...and reviews are very helpful![/i]

[h1]Update v.1.1.0[/h1]

- Added a hacking selection UI on first boot
- Changed terminal pause to be on by default
- Increased clarity in hacking tutorial and rewrote it to consider terminal pause being on by default
- Renamed "Message" to "Manifesto"
- Added additional option for ICEbreaker to upgrade based on timer
- Adjusted minor things in Program Alone, Program Distributed
- Fixed bug in main menu where reset input confirmation wasn't showing
- Fixed a big bug in Nim
